context.notes: The harness owns the canonical transcript; an agent's own session is a cache that may be lost. Handoff is full replay pasted ahead of the user's message, never an injection into the other agent's session. Agents publish artifacts by writing files into .awos/artifacts/ — a file convention, not a tool. Claude and Codex adapters speak their CLI protocols directly; Qwen Code uses the pinned SDK against the configured local OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
